_meta.note: These rules govern ALL episode production. Any automation, agent, or pipeline step must check this file first.

pipeline_order: 1. Load show_bible.json and confirm locked rules
4. Pull character assets from Google Drive CHARACTERS folder
5. Pull location reference images if available
6. Pull song assets from Google Drive MUSIC folder
8. Generate missing images using nano_banana_2 — one image per beat — with CHARACTER LOCK HEADER prepended to every prompt
9. Generate video clips shot-by-shot from the timeline file — one clip per beat
10. Verify no clip is used more than once
11. Assemble clips in timeline order using Higgsfield explainer_video
13. Export final episode to Google Drive FINALS — READY TO UPLOAD folder
14. Prepare YouTube Studio upload metadata — mark Made for Kids

generation_rules.prompt_rule: Every prompt MUST begin with the CHARACTER LOCK HEADER from show_bible.json
generation_rules.clip_looping: PROHIBITED — every clip must be unique and used only once
generation_rules.clip_generation_order: Generate clips in timeline order (Beat 1 first, final beat last)
generation_rules.existing_asset_preference: Use existing Higgsfield image IDs before generating new images

assembly_rules.shot_sequence: Clips are sequenced in ascending beat order — no random ordering
assembly_rules.transition: Simple cuts only — no effects between clips unless creator-specified
assembly_rules.music_sync: Theme song attached to ACT 1; episode song attached to ACT 3; outro sting to ACT 4
assembly_rules.no_gap: No silent black frames between clips — assembly must be seamless

delivery_rules.google_drive_destination: Sunny and the Crew — Production → FINALS — READY TO UPLOAD
delivery_rules.make_delivery: Use Make.com scenario 5575994 to download from Higgsfield CDN and upload to Google Drive

prohibited_actions: Asking creator to paste API keys into chat
Connecting JD Life With FND to any Sunny and the Crew activity
Connecting Gigi's Playhouse assets or folders to this production
Using any model other than nano_banana_2 for character generation
Random scene generation not based on beat sheet
quality_checks: Verify clip count matches beat count before assembly
Verify no clip ID appears twice in timeline
Verify CHARACTER LOCK HEADER was used in every image prompt
Verify total runtime is between 5:00 and 8:00
Verify outro ends with Sunny wave goodbye (asset 3d56c3cb or equivalent)
Verify theme song is at the start of ACT 1
Verify episode song covers full duration of ACT 3

VERIFICATION_PROTOCOL.description: Before flagging any character, location, image, job ID, element ID, or asset as missing, pending, or ungenerated — complete ALL four steps below. Only after zero results across all four steps may you declare something missing.
steps: STEP 1 — Search characters.json and locations.json for the item by ID, name, and all known aliases
STEP 2 — Search the Google Drive CHARACTERS folder and all subfolders for any document or image file containing the character name
STEP 3 — Search the Google Drive LOCATIONS folder and all subfolders for any document or image file containing the location name
STEP 4 — Search all past chat context, reference documents, and JSON files in Drive for job IDs, element IDs, or pose IDs
VERIFICATION_PROTOCOL.if_found_in_drive_but_not_repo: Import into repo immediately and update the relevant JSON file. Do not ask permission. Do not flag as open item. Fix it.
VERIFICATION_PROTOCOL.applies_to: Every task, every session, every time — no exceptions
VERIFICATION_PROTOCOL.self_check: I will not tell the creator something is missing until I have searched Drive. I will not ask the creator to provide information that is already in Drive.
